notes:
Original statistics mentioned secondhand in the replication report were not substituted for unavailable original primary-paper extraction. The replication target is the four-product full-sample test, not the three-product or prior-exposure-restricted sensitivity analyses. Replication sample size is the report's 603 participants, supported by the linked primary analysis code stating no exclusions. No statistics were computed or converted. Exclusions documentation: /home/lukas/.t3/worktrees/fred-data/audit-fred-stats-2026-10/audit/fred_stats_2026-10/texts/eac5f5fc3f63fe54af17d108.txt (section 3.2).
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Supplied source is the published Journal of Marketing Research article, 2019, 56(2), 230–244, title and DOI matched in canonical text. Visually inspected rendered PDF pages 6 and 7 (published pp.235–236). Canonical-text quotes preserve extraction glyphs: ¼ represents the rendered equals sign, and Z2 represents rendered eta-squared (η²); the printed result is partial η² = .029. Table 2 rounds the same overall p to .02; the Results paragraph supplies .016, retained here with its matching effect size. No statistic conversion. Perceived control is not the Study 1b outcome; the located target is its overall new-product purchase-likelihood main effect. Unassigned replication and narrative-success fields are placeholders only.
